notes: The older preserved guidance already contained source anchors, but had never been enabled as a complete prepared rendering pack. Anchors were visually rechecked on the cited alternate Vilna scan and reconciled with the pinned canonical source.

Rashi is on the left and Tosafot on the right. Exactly four broad opening rows; the fifth commentary row belongs to each side column, even where it sits above the first Gemara baseline. The older five-wide-row description is superseded, not used for rendering.
Gemara has 53 narrow rows and a final row widened left below completed Rashi. Tosafot has 64 side rows after its opening and two full-width footer rows.
Gemara row 17 prints דביזרי; canonical (דביזרי) [דבי דרי] is preserved as one explicit display variant. All source IDs remain retained.
Isolated next-page previews וכן and ירדן are omitted. The original guidance and saved teacher-approved snapshots remain preserved.
Preparation and connection do not create teacher approval. No model/API calls are needed to load this page.
